description: Kernel-mystery probe (T-1778 round 3, erfc-probes): coarse localisation of the ERF/ERFC branch switch over the round-2 bracket (0.49922, 0.5171), in case it is not at 0.5 exactly. Rows are x = 0.4990 + k*1E-5 + 6.18E-8 for k = 0..1849 (not consecutive doubles). A = x, B = ERF.PRECISE(x), C = ERFC.PRECISE(x), D = ERFC.PRECISE(-x).
